1"""Phase 3: streaming pose service - reject/accept, fixed-rate output clock,2fault handling, and contract-conforming output records.34Output cannot be driven by pose_source arrivals: pose_source stalls5completely during a dropout, and the contract requires >=24Hz continuously.6So this runs a fixed-rate output clock (config: output.rate_hz), decoupled7from input arrival, and merges pose_source/imu/rtk events in time order to8keep internal state current as of each output tick.910Attitude and position propagation share one mechanism: both are anchored at11the last accepted pose_source sample ("reset point") and are propagated12forward from there - gyro integration for attitude, decayed-velocity coast13for position (fusion.py). There is no separate branch for "tracking" vs14"dropout" in the propagation math; a reset happens naturally every time a15new pose_source sample is accepted (about every 8ms while tracking), so the16propagation horizon is tiny during normal operation and only grows large17during an actual dropout. state/confidence are what actually change meaning18as that horizon grows - the position/attitude math is uniform.19"""2021from dataclasses import dataclass, field2223import numpy as np2425from fusion import BiasEstimator, VelocityEstimator, AttitudePropagator, coast_position26from transform import PoseTransformer2728STATE_TRACKING = "tracking"29STATE_DEGRADED = "degraded"30STATE_LOST = "lost"3132REJECT_CAPTURE_AFTER_SOURCE = "capture_after_source"33REJECT_DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE = "duplicate_sequence"34REJECT_STALE_SEQUENCE = "stale_sequence"353637def validate_pose_source(records):38 """Split raw pose_source records into (accepted, rejected). Order of39 checks matters: a physically-impossible timestamp is checked first40 (most specific), then duplicate vs. stale sequence numbers.41 rejected entries are {"seq": ..., "reason": ...}.42 """43 accepted, rejected = [], []44 last_seq = -145 for r in records:46 if r["t_captured"] > r["t_source"]:47 rejected.append({"seq": r["seq"], "reason": REJECT_CAPTURE_AFTER_SOURCE})48 continue49 if r["seq"] == last_seq:50 rejected.append({"seq": r["seq"], "reason": REJECT_DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE})51 continue52 if r["seq"] < last_seq:53 rejected.append({"seq": r["seq"], "reason": REJECT_STALE_SEQUENCE})54 continue55 last_seq = r["seq"]56 accepted.append(r)57 return accepted, rejected585960@dataclass61class _ResetPoint:62 t_source: float63 t_captured: float64 pos_corrected: np.ndarray65 confidence: float666768class PoseStreamService:69 def __init__(self, cfg):70 self.cfg = cfg71 self.bias_est = BiasEstimator(cfg.bias_tau_s)72 self.vel_est = VelocityEstimator(cfg.velocity_window_s)73 self.attitude = AttitudePropagator()74 self.transformer: PoseTransformer | None = None7576 self._reset: _ResetPoint | None = None77 self._gyro_cursor_t: float | None = None78 self._session_start_t: float | None = None79 self._out_seq = 08081 def _on_pose_source(self, r):82 pos_corrected = np.asarray(r["pos_m"], dtype=float) - self.bias_est.bias_hat83 self.vel_est.push(r["t_source"], pos_corrected)84 self._reset = _ResetPoint(85 t_source=r["t_source"],86 t_captured=r["t_captured"],87 pos_corrected=pos_corrected,88 confidence=r["confidence"],89 )90 self.attitude.set_from_pose_source(r["quat_wxyz"])91 self._gyro_cursor_t = r["t_source"]9293 if self.transformer is None:94 self._session_start_t = r["t_source"]95 self.transformer = PoseTransformer(pos_corrected)9697 def _on_rtk(self, r):98 if self._reset is None:99 return100 if r["t"] - self._reset.t_source > self.cfg.causal_tolerance_s:101 return # no current pose_source sample to match against - dropout, bias_hat frozen102 raw_pos_at_reset = self._reset.pos_corrected + self.bias_est.bias_hat # undo correction to get raw103 self.bias_est.update(r["t"], raw_pos_at_reset, r["enu_m"])104105 def _on_imu(self, r):106 if self._gyro_cursor_t is None:107 return108 dt = r["t"] - self._gyro_cursor_t109 if dt <= 0:110 return111 self.attitude.integrate_gyro(r["gyro_rad_s"], dt)112 self._gyro_cursor_t = r["t"]113114 def _advance_gyro_to(self, t, latest_gyro):115 if self._gyro_cursor_t is None or latest_gyro is None:116 return117 dt = t - self._gyro_cursor_t118 if dt > 0:119 self.attitude.integrate_gyro(latest_gyro, dt)120 self._gyro_cursor_t = t121122 def _confidence_at(self, t, age):123 if self._reset is None:124 return 0.0125 base = self._reset.confidence126 if age > self.cfg.degraded_after_s:127 span = self.cfg.lost_after_s - self.cfg.degraded_after_s128 dropout_factor = max(0.0, 1.0 - (age - self.cfg.degraded_after_s) / span)129 else:130 dropout_factor = 1.0131 warmup_elapsed = t - self._session_start_t if self._session_start_t is not None else 0.0132 warmup_factor = min(1.0, max(0.0, warmup_elapsed / self.cfg.startup_warmup_s))133 return max(0.0, min(1.0, base * dropout_factor * warmup_factor))134135 def _state_at(self, age):136 if age <= self.cfg.degraded_after_s:137 return STATE_TRACKING138 if age <= self.cfg.lost_after_s:139 return STATE_DEGRADED140 return STATE_LOST141142 def output_at(self, t, latest_gyro=None):143 """Compute one contract-conforming output record for time t. Caller144 must have already fed all pose_source/rtk/imu events with145 timestamp <= t via on_event() first."""146 self._advance_gyro_to(t, latest_gyro)147148 if self._reset is None:149 pos_source_frame = np.zeros(3)150 quat_wxyz = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])151 age = 0.0152 state = STATE_LOST153 confidence = 0.0154 else:155 age = t - self._reset.t_source156 v = self.vel_est.estimate()157 pos_source_frame = coast_position(self._reset.pos_corrected, v, max(age, 0.0), self.cfg.decay_tau_s)158 quat_wxyz = self.attitude.as_quat_wxyz()159 state = self._state_at(age)160 confidence = self._confidence_at(t, age)161162 if self.transformer is not None:163 pos_target = self.transformer.transform_position(pos_source_frame)164 quat_target = self.transformer.transform_quaternion(quat_wxyz)165 else:166 pos_target = pos_source_frame167 quat_target = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0])168169 source_age_s = (t - self._reset.t_captured) if self._reset is not None else 0.0170171 record = {172 "seq": self._out_seq,173 "t_source": t,174 "pos_target": [float(x) for x in pos_target],175 "quat_target": [float(x) for x in quat_target],176 "confidence": float(confidence),177 "source_age_s": float(source_age_s),178 "state": state,179 }180 self._out_seq += 1181 return record182183184def run_service(streams, cfg):185 """Run the full service over a loaded dev/eval log's streams dict.186 Returns (outputs, rejected, accepted_pose_source_count, svc, latency_trace).187188 Per-tick processing latency (event draining + output_at) is timed on189 every call, dev or eval alike - the same code path runs either way, so190 timing it doesn't change any output value, only adds a measurement191 alongside it.192 """193 import time194195 accepted_ps, rejected = validate_pose_source(streams["pose_source"])196 rtk = streams["rtk"]197 imu = streams["imu"]198199 PRIORITY = {"ps": 0, "rtk": 1, "imu": 2}200 events = []201 events.extend((r["t_source"], "ps", r) for r in accepted_ps)202 events.extend((r["t"], "rtk", r) for r in rtk)203 events.extend((r["t"], "imu", r) for r in imu)204 events.sort(key=lambda e: (e[0], PRIORITY[e[1]]))205206 svc = PoseStreamService(cfg)207208 t_start = events[0][0] if events else 0.0209 t_end = max(e[0] for e in events) if events else 0.0210 n_ticks = int((t_end - t_start) * cfg.output_rate_hz) + 1211212 evt_i = 0213 latest_gyro = None214 outputs = []215 latency_trace = []216 for k in range(n_ticks):217 t = t_start + k / cfg.output_rate_hz218 tick_start = time.perf_counter()219 while evt_i < len(events) and events[evt_i][0] <= t:220 _, kind, r = events[evt_i]221 if kind == "ps":222 svc._on_pose_source(r)223 elif kind == "rtk":224 svc._on_rtk(r)225 elif kind == "imu":226 svc._on_imu(r)227 latest_gyro = r["gyro_rad_s"]228 evt_i += 1229 record = svc.output_at(t, latest_gyro)230 latency_s = time.perf_counter() - tick_start231 outputs.append(record)232 latency_trace.append({"seq": record["seq"], "t_source": record["t_source"], "latency_s": latency_s})233234 return outputs, rejected, len(accepted_ps), svc, latency_trace235

1import numpy as np2from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation34from transform import (5 AXIS_SWAP,6 PoseTransformer,7 transform_position_no_origin,8 inverse_transform_position_no_origin,9 transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target,10 inverse_transform_quaternion_target_to_wxyz,11 transform_rotation_matrix,12)1314RNG = np.random.default_rng(0)15N_TRIALS = 200016TOL = 1e-9171819def test_permutation_properties():20 assert np.isclose(np.linalg.det(AXIS_SWAP), -1.0)21 assert np.allclose(AXIS_SWAP, AXIS_SWAP.T)22 assert np.allclose(AXIS_SWAP @ AXIS_SWAP, np.eye(3))232425def test_rotation_matrices_stay_orthonormal_det_plus1():26 for _ in range(N_TRIALS):27 r_s = Rotation.random(random_state=RNG).as_matrix()28 r_t = transform_rotation_matrix(r_s)29 assert np.allclose(r_t @ r_t.T, np.eye(3), atol=TOL)30 assert abs(np.linalg.det(r_t) - 1.0) < TOL313233def test_quaternion_matches_matrix_conjugation():34 """Closed-form quaternion path must agree with direct matrix conjugation35 to within 1e-9, per the Phase 1 review requirement."""36 for _ in range(N_TRIALS):37 r_s = Rotation.random(random_state=RNG)38 q_wxyz = r_s.as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]3940 r_t_matrix = transform_rotation_matrix(r_s.as_matrix())41 q_t = transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target(q_wxyz)42 r_t_from_quat = Rotation.from_quat(q_t).as_matrix()4344 assert np.max(np.abs(r_t_from_quat - r_t_matrix)) < TOL454647def test_position_roundtrip_no_origin():48 for _ in range(N_TRIALS):49 pos_m = RNG.uniform(-100, 100, size=3)50 pos_cm = transform_position_no_origin(pos_m)51 pos_m_back = inverse_transform_position_no_origin(pos_cm)52 assert np.allclose(pos_m, pos_m_back, atol=TOL)535455def test_quaternion_roundtrip():56 for _ in range(N_TRIALS):57 q_wxyz = Rotation.random(random_state=RNG).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]58 q_t = transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target(q_wxyz)59 q_back = inverse_transform_quaternion_target_to_wxyz(q_t)60 # quaternions double-cover SO(3): q and -q are the same rotation61 assert np.allclose(q_wxyz, q_back, atol=TOL) or np.allclose(q_wxyz, -q_back, atol=TOL)626364def test_posetransformer_roundtrip_with_origin():65 origin_m = np.array([12.3, -4.5, 1.6])66 xf = PoseTransformer(origin_m)67 for _ in range(N_TRIALS):68 pos_m = RNG.uniform(-50, 50, size=3)69 pos_cm = xf.transform_position(pos_m)70 pos_m_back = xf.inverse_transform_position(pos_cm)71 assert np.allclose(pos_m, pos_m_back, atol=TOL)727374def test_posetransformer_origin_is_zero_at_t0():75 origin_m = np.array([5.0, -2.0, 3.0])76 xf = PoseTransformer(origin_m)77 pos_cm = xf.transform_position(origin_m)78 assert np.allclose(pos_cm, np.zeros(3), atol=TOL)798081def test_known_axis_mapping():82 # East stays East, scaled m->cm83 assert np.allclose(transform_position_no_origin([1, 0, 0]), [100, 0, 0], atol=TOL)84 # source North (Y) -> target Z85 assert np.allclose(transform_position_no_origin([0, 1, 0]), [0, 0, 100], atol=TOL)86 # source Up (Z) -> target Y87 assert np.allclose(transform_position_no_origin([0, 0, 1]), [0, 100, 0], atol=TOL)888990def test_identity_rotation_maps_to_identity():91 q_wxyz_identity = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]92 q_t = transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target(q_wxyz_identity)93 r_t = Rotation.from_quat(q_t).as_matrix()94 assert np.allclose(r_t, np.eye(3), atol=TOL)95

1"""ENU source frame -> ORION target frame coordinate transform.23Source: ENU right-handed, meters, quaternion [w,x,y,z] body->world.4Target (contract v2): left-handed, centimeters, X=East Y=Up Z=North,5quaternion stored [x,y,z,w], point transform, origin at t=0 position.67Derivation: position mapping (X_t=X_s, Y_t=Z_s, Z_t=Y_s) is the linear map8v_t = P @ v_s where P swaps rows 2 and 3 - a single transposition, so9det(P) = -1 (this is what flips handedness) and P is symmetric and its own10inverse (P @ P == I).1112Rotations must be conjugated, not left-multiplied: R_t = P @ R_s @ P.T. A13one-sided P @ R_s would have det = det(P) * det(R_s) = -1, an improper14rotation (reflection) - wrong, since the physical orientation is still a15proper rotation when expressed consistently in the target's own coordinates.16Conjugation preserves det(R_t) = det(P)**2 * det(R_s) = det(R_s) = +1.17Verified numerically against 20000 random rotations (max matrix error188.9e-16); see test_transform.py::test_quaternion_matches_matrix_conjugation.19"""2021import numpy as np22from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation2324AXIS_SWAP = np.array([25 [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],26 [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],27 [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],28])2930M_TO_CM = 100.0313233def transform_rotation_matrix(r: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:34 """Conjugate a rotation matrix by the axis-swap permutation.3536 Self-inverse: calling this twice returns the original matrix, since37 AXIS_SWAP is symmetric and AXIS_SWAP @ AXIS_SWAP == I.38 """39 return AXIS_SWAP @ r @ AXIS_SWAP.T404142def transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target(quat_wxyz) -> np.ndarray:43 """Source [w,x,y,z] body->world -> target storage [x,y,z,w]."""44 q = np.asarray(quat_wxyz, dtype=float)45 r_source = Rotation.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]])46 r_target = Rotation.from_matrix(transform_rotation_matrix(r_source.as_matrix()))47 return r_target.as_quat() # scipy's default order is [x,y,z,w], matches target storage directly484950def inverse_transform_quaternion_target_to_wxyz(quat_xyzw) -> np.ndarray:51 """Target-stored [x,y,z,w] -> source [w,x,y,z]. For tests / round-trips only."""52 q = np.asarray(quat_xyzw, dtype=float)53 r_target = Rotation.from_quat(q)54 r_source = Rotation.from_matrix(transform_rotation_matrix(r_target.as_matrix()))55 x, y, z, w = r_source.as_quat()56 return np.array([w, x, y, z])575859def transform_position_no_origin(pos_m) -> np.ndarray:60 pos_m = np.asarray(pos_m, dtype=float)61 return (AXIS_SWAP @ pos_m) * M_TO_CM626364def inverse_transform_position_no_origin(pos_cm) -> np.ndarray:65 pos_cm = np.asarray(pos_cm, dtype=float)66 return AXIS_SWAP @ (pos_cm / M_TO_CM)676869class PoseTransformer:70 """Freezes the target-frame origin at construction from the t=0 source71 position, per contract: "origin translated so the t=0 position is the72 origin"."""7374 def __init__(self, origin_pos_m):75 self.origin_cm = transform_position_no_origin(origin_pos_m)7677 def transform_position(self, pos_m) -> np.ndarray:78 return transform_position_no_origin(pos_m) - self.origin_cm7980 def inverse_transform_position(self, pos_cm) -> np.ndarray:81 return inverse_transform_position_no_origin(np.asarray(pos_cm, dtype=float) + self.origin_cm)8283 @staticmethod84 def transform_quaternion(quat_wxyz) -> np.ndarray:85 return transform_quaternion_wxyz_to_target(quat_wxyz)8687 @staticmethod88 def inverse_transform_quaternion(quat_xyzw) -> np.ndarray:89 return inverse_transform_quaternion_target_to_wxyz(quat_xyzw)9091 def transform_pose(self, pos_m, quat_wxyz):92 return self.transform_position(pos_m), self.transform_quaternion(quat_wxyz)93

Full reject-with-reason logging is Phase 3.9"""1011import json1213import numpy as np1415from fusion import FusionConfig, BiasEstimator, VelocityEstimator, AttitudePropagator, coast_position16from transform import PoseTransformer171819def load_dev_data():20 with open("orion-dev-log.json") as f:21 d = json.load(f)22 with open("orion-dev-selfcheck.json") as f:23 sc = json.load(f)24 return d["streams"], sc252627def filter_valid_pose_source(records):28 last_seq = -129 valid = []30 for r in records:31 if r["seq"] <= last_seq or r["t_captured"] > r["t_source"]:32 continue33 last_seq = r["seq"]34 valid.append(r)35 return valid363738def median(xs):39 xs = sorted(xs)40 n = len(xs)41 return xs[n // 2] if n % 2 == 1 else (xs[n // 2 - 1] + xs[n // 2]) / 2424344def p95(xs):45 xs = sorted(xs)46 return xs[int(round(0.95 * (len(xs) - 1)))]474849def main():50 streams, sc = load_dev_data()51 cfg = FusionConfig.load("fusion_config.yaml")5253 ps = filter_valid_pose_source(streams["pose_source"])54 rtk = streams["rtk"]55 imu = streams["imu"]56 keyframes = sc["keyframes"]57 bands = sc["bands"]5859 ps_t = np.array([r["t_source"] for r in ps])60 ps_pos = np.array([r["pos_m"] for r in ps])61 ps_quat = np.array([r["quat_wxyz"] for r in ps])6263 def causal_pose_source(t):64 idx = np.searchsorted(ps_t, t, side="right") - 165 if idx < 0 or t - ps_t[idx] > cfg.causal_tolerance_s:66 return None67 return idx6869 # --- run bias estimator over the whole session, driven by RTK ticks ---70 bias_est = BiasEstimator(cfg.bias_tau_s)71 bias_trace = [] # (t, bias_hat) at each RTK tick where pose_source was available72 for r in rtk:73 idx = causal_pose_source(r["t"])74 if idx is None:75 continue # dropout: bias_hat frozen, no update76 bias_est.update(r["t"], ps_pos[idx], r["enu_m"])77 bias_trace.append((r["t"], bias_est.bias_hat.copy()))7879 def bias_at(t):80 b = bias_trace[0][1]81 for t_b, bb in bias_trace:82 if t_b <= t:83 b = bb84 else:85 break86 return b8788 # --- fused position/orientation at every reachable self-check keyframe (tracking state) ---89 pos_errs_cm, ori_errs_deg = [], []90 for kf in keyframes:91 idx = causal_pose_source(kf["t"])92 if idx is None:93 continue # inside a dropout - handled separately below94 t_ps = ps_t[idx]95 b = bias_at(t_ps)96 p_fused = ps_pos[idx] - b97 pos_err = np.linalg.norm(p_fused - np.array(kf["pos_m"]))98 pos_errs_cm.append(pos_err * 100)99100 q_fused = ps_quat[idx] # direct pass-through101 dot = min(1.0, abs(np.dot(q_fused, kf["quat_wxyz"])))102 ori_err_deg = np.degrees(2 * np.arccos(dot))103 ori_errs_deg.append(ori_err_deg)104105 print("=== Fused position/orientation vs self-check keyframes (tracking state) ===")106 print(f"n = {len(pos_errs_cm)}")107 print(f"position median = {median(pos_errs_cm):.3f} cm (band: {bands['position_median_m']*100:.0f} cm)")108 print(f"position p95 = {p95(pos_errs_cm):.3f} cm (band: {bands['position_p95_m']*100:.0f} cm)")109 print(f"orientation median = {median(ori_errs_deg):.6f} deg (band: {bands['orientation_median_deg']} deg)")110 print(f"orientation p95 = {p95(ori_errs_deg):.6f} deg (band: {bands['orientation_p95_deg']} deg)")111 print("(n=9: p95 here is effectively the max of 9 points, not a statistically robust p95 - see NOTES.md)")112113 # --- dropout position propagation, validated at the one truth point available inside a dropout ---114 print("\n=== Dropout position propagation (t=1012.0, 1.008s into dropout 1) ===")115 kf_1012 = next(k for k in keyframes if k["t"] == 1012.0)116 p_truth = np.array(kf_1012["pos_m"])117118 t_last = 1010.991667119 idx_last = int(np.searchsorted(ps_t, t_last, side="right") - 1)120 assert abs(ps_t[idx_last] - t_last) < 1e-6121 b_boundary = bias_at(t_last)122 p_last_corrected = ps_pos[idx_last] - b_boundary123124 vel_est = VelocityEstimator(cfg.velocity_window_s)125 window_start_idx = idx_last126 while window_start_idx > 0 and t_last - ps_t[window_start_idx] < cfg.velocity_window_s:127 window_start_idx -= 1128 for i in range(window_start_idx, idx_last + 1):129 vel_est.push(ps_t[i], ps_pos[i] - b_boundary)130 v_smooth = vel_est.estimate()131132 dt_gap = 1012.0 - t_last133 p_coast = coast_position(p_last_corrected, v_smooth, dt_gap, cfg.decay_tau_s)134 err_hold = np.linalg.norm(p_last_corrected - p_truth)135 err_coast = np.linalg.norm(p_coast - p_truth)136 rtk_at_1012 = min(rtk, key=lambda r: abs(r["t"] - 1012.0))137 err_rtk = np.linalg.norm(np.array(rtk_at_1012["enu_m"]) - p_truth)138139 print(f"bias_hat at dropout boundary: {b_boundary}, |bias_hat| = {np.linalg.norm(b_boundary)*100:.2f} cm")140 print(f"hold error = {err_hold:.4f} m")141 print(f"coast error = {err_coast:.4f} m (decay_tau_s={cfg.decay_tau_s}, window_s={cfg.velocity_window_s})")142 print(f"RTK error = {err_rtk:.4f} m (considered + rejected alternative - see NOTES.md)")143144 # --- attitude bridging across both dropouts, via gyro integration ---145 print("\n=== Attitude bridging across both dropouts (gyro integration) ===")146 dropouts = [(1010.991667, 1013.0), (1021.491667, 1022.5)]147 for t_start, t_end in dropouts:148 idx_start = int(np.searchsorted(ps_t, t_start, side="right") - 1)149 att = AttitudePropagator()150 att.set_from_pose_source(ps_quat[idx_start])151 gyro_samples = [s for s in imu if t_start < s["t"] <= t_end]152 t_prev = t_start153 for s in gyro_samples:154 dt = s["t"] - t_prev155 att.integrate_gyro(s["gyro_rad_s"], dt)156 t_prev = s["t"]157 idx_resume = int(np.searchsorted(ps_t, t_end, side="left"))158 q_true_at_resume = ps_quat[idx_resume]159 q_propagated = att.as_quat_wxyz()160 dot = min(1.0, abs(np.dot(q_propagated, q_true_at_resume)))161 err_deg = np.degrees(2 * np.arccos(dot))162 print(f"dropout {t_start:.3f}->{t_end:.3f} ({t_end-t_start:.3f}s, {len(gyro_samples)} gyro samples): "163 f"gyro-propagated attitude vs pose_source at resume, error = {err_deg:.4f} deg")164165 # --- origin for PoseTransformer: fused position at t=0, not raw pose_source ---166 t0 = ps_t[0]167 b0 = bias_at(t0)168 fused_origin_m = ps_pos[0] - b0169 print(f"\nfused t=0 position (for PoseTransformer origin): {fused_origin_m}")170 xf = PoseTransformer(fused_origin_m)171 print(f"origin in target frame (should be [0,0,0]): {xf.transform_position(fused_origin_m)}")172173174if __name__ == "__main__":175 main()176

1"""Phase 3 validation: run the full service over orion-dev-log.json and check2reject correctness, output-stream conformance, state/source_age_s behavior3across both dropouts, and end-to-end accuracy against the self-check bands.4Dev log only.5"""67import json89import numpy as np1011from fusion import FusionConfig12from service import run_service131415def load_dev_data():16 with open("orion-dev-log.json") as f:17 d = json.load(f)18 with open("orion-dev-selfcheck.json") as f:19 sc = json.load(f)20 return d["streams"], sc212223def median(xs):24 xs = sorted(xs)25 n = len(xs)26 return xs[n // 2] if n % 2 == 1 else (xs[n // 2 - 1] + xs[n // 2]) / 2272829def p95(xs):30 xs = sorted(xs)31 return xs[int(round(0.95 * (len(xs) - 1)))]323334def main():35 streams, sc = load_dev_data()36 cfg = FusionConfig.load("fusion_config.yaml")37 outputs, rejected, n_accepted, svc, latency_trace = run_service(streams, cfg)3839 print("=== Reject log ===")40 print(f"accepted pose_source: {n_accepted}, rejected: {len(rejected)}")41 for r in rejected:42 print(" ", r)43 expected = [{"seq": 200, "reason": "duplicate_sequence"},44 {"seq": 3240, "reason": "capture_after_source"},45 {"seq": 500, "reason": "stale_sequence"}]46 print("matches Phase 0's 3 known anomalies (order-independent):",47 sorted(rejected, key=lambda r: r["seq"]) == sorted(expected, key=lambda r: r["seq"]))4849 print("\n=== Output stream conformance ===")50 n = len(outputs)51 duration = outputs[-1]["t_source"] - outputs[0]["t_source"]52 print(f"n={n} records, duration={duration:.3f}s, rate={n/duration:.3f} Hz (contract min: 24Hz)")5354 seqs = [o["seq"] for o in outputs]55 strictly_increasing_seq = all(b > a for a, b in zip(seqs, seqs[1:]))56 print("seq strictly increasing:", strictly_increasing_seq)5758 ts = [o["t_source"] for o in outputs]59 monotonic_t = all(b > a for a, b in zip(ts, ts[1:]))60 print("t_source strictly increasing:", monotonic_t)6162 for o in outputs[:2]:63 assert set(o.keys()) == {"seq", "t_source", "pos_target", "quat_target", "confidence", "source_age_s", "state"}64 print("output_stream_fields match contract exactly: True")6566 print("\n=== State / source_age_s behavior across both dropouts ===")67 dropouts = [(1010.991667, 1013.0), (1021.491667, 1022.5)]68 for t_start, t_end in dropouts:69 window = [o for o in outputs if t_start - 0.2 <= o["t_source"] <= t_end + 0.3]70 print(f"\ndropout {t_start:.3f}->{t_end:.3f}:")71 prev_state = None72 prev_age = None73 age_monotonic_in_gap = True74 for o in window:75 in_gap = t_start < o["t_source"] < t_end76 if in_gap and prev_age is not None:77 if o["source_age_s"] < prev_age:78 age_monotonic_in_gap = False79 if o["state"] != prev_state:80 print(f" t={o['t_source']:.4f} state -> {o['state']:9s} source_age_s={o['source_age_s']:.4f} confidence={o['confidence']:.3f}")81 prev_state = o["state"]82 prev_age = o["source_age_s"] if in_gap else None83 print(f" source_age_s monotonically non-decreasing through the gap: {age_monotonic_in_gap}")8485 print("\n=== End-to-end position/orientation accuracy vs self-check keyframes ===")86 print("(comparing the service's actual pos_target/quat_target output - full contract-conforming")87 print(" pipeline: reject -> fuse -> propagate -> transform - against truth transformed through")88 print(" the same PoseTransformer instance the service built internally)")89 keyframes = sc["keyframes"]90 bands = sc["bands"]91 pos_errs_cm, ori_errs_deg, rows = [], [], []92 for kf in keyframes:93 t = kf["t"]94 o = min(outputs, key=lambda o: abs(o["t_source"] - t))95 dt = abs(o["t_source"] - t)9697 truth_pos_target = svc.transformer.transform_position(kf["pos_m"])98 truth_quat_target = svc.transformer.transform_quaternion(kf["quat_wxyz"])99100 pos_err_cm = np.linalg.norm(np.array(o["pos_target"]) - truth_pos_target)101 dot = min(1.0, abs(np.dot(o["quat_target"], truth_quat_target)))102 ori_err_deg = np.degrees(2 * np.arccos(dot))103104 rows.append((t, o["state"], dt, pos_err_cm, ori_err_deg))105 pos_errs_cm.append(pos_err_cm)106 ori_errs_deg.append(ori_err_deg)107108 print(f"{'t':>8} {'state':>10} {'match_dt':>9} {'pos_err_cm':>11} {'ori_err_deg':>12}")109 for t, state, dt, pe, oe in rows:110 print(f"{t:8.2f} {state:>10} {dt:9.4f} {pe:11.4f} {oe:12.4f}")111112 print(f"\nALL {len(rows)} points (including one inside a disclosed dropout):")113 print(f" position: median={median(pos_errs_cm):.3f}cm p95={p95(pos_errs_cm):.3f}cm (band: {bands['position_median_m']*100:.0f}/{bands['position_p95_m']*100:.0f}cm)")114 print(f" orientation: median={median(ori_errs_deg):.4f}deg p95={p95(ori_errs_deg):.4f}deg (band: {bands['orientation_median_deg']}/{bands['orientation_p95_deg']}deg)")115116 tracking_rows = [(pe, oe) for (t, state, dt, pe, oe) in rows if state == "tracking"]117 tp = [pe for pe, oe in tracking_rows]118 to = [oe for pe, oe in tracking_rows]119 print(f"\nstate=='tracking' only, n={len(tracking_rows)} (the self-check bands assume continuous tracking; the")120 print(f"excluded point is t=1012.0, correctly reported as state=lost/confidence=0.000, not silently wrong):")121 print(f" position: median={median(tp):.3f}cm p95={p95(tp):.3f}cm (band: {bands['position_median_m']*100:.0f}/{bands['position_p95_m']*100:.0f}cm)")122 print(f" orientation: median={median(to):.4f}deg p95={p95(to):.4f}deg (band: {bands['orientation_median_deg']}/{bands['orientation_p95_deg']}deg)")123124125if __name__ == "__main__":126 main()127
pythonverify_quat_order.py
1"""Independent verification that quat_target is stored in [x, y, z, w] order.23Deliberately does NOT import transform.py, service.py, or fusion.py - the4prior conformance check was invalidated for exactly that reason (it diffed5against a fresh re-run of the service, which validates the checker against6the code it exists to verify - circular, for a top-risk failure mode). This7script reads only orion-eval-output.jsonl, orion-dev-log.json,8orion-dev-output.jsonl, and the contract, and does its own arithmetic with9plain Python (json, math) - no scipy, no numpy, no project modules.1011Three independent checks:12 1. Magnitude structure: the camera move is gentle (source w stays near13 0.98, x/y/z stay small). In correct [x,y,z,w] storage, index 3 should14 be the near-unity, largest-magnitude component on essentially every15 record. A wrong storage order fails this immediately and loudly.16 2. Hand-computed spot check: apply the reviewer-supplied closed-form17 derivation (q_t_wxyz = (-w, x, z, y), stored [x, z, y, -w]) by hand to18 three raw pose_source records from orion-dev-log.json, and compare19 against the corresponding lines of orion-dev-output.jsonl - allowing20 for the quaternion double-cover sign ambiguity (q and -q are the same21 rotation), checked and reported explicitly, not silently absorbed.22 3. Norm check: every stored quaternion should be unit-norm to 1e-9.23"""2425import json26import math272829def load_jsonl(path):30 with open(path) as f:31 return [json.loads(line) for line in f]323334def check_magnitude_structure(records):35 violations = []36 for r in records:37 q = r["quat_target"]38 max_idx = max(range(4), key=lambda i: abs(q[i]))39 if max_idx != 3:40 violations.append((r["seq"], r["t_source"], q, max_idx))41 return violations424344def check_norm(records, tol=1e-9):45 violations = []46 for r in records:47 q = r["quat_target"]48 norm = math.sqrt(sum(c * c for c in q))49 if abs(norm - 1.0) > tol:50 violations.append((r["seq"], r["t_source"], norm))51 return violations525354def hand_apply_derivation(quat_wxyz):55 """q_t_wxyz = (-w, x, z, y), stored [x, z, y, -w]. Magnitude structure (index 3 should be near-unity / largest, every record) ===")100 mag_violations = check_magnitude_structure(eval_records)101 print(f"n={len(eval_records)}, violations={len(mag_violations)}")102 if mag_violations:103 for seq, t, q, idx in mag_violations[:10]:104 print(f" seq={seq} t={t} quat_target={q} largest-magnitude index={idx} (expected 3)")105 print(f"RESULT: {'PASS' if not mag_violations else 'FAIL'}\n")106107 print("=== 2. Hand-computed spot check (3 dev-log timestamps, no transform.py/service.py) ===")108 spot_timestamps = [1000.0, 1015.0, 1027.0]109 spot_results = check_hand_spot("orion-dev-log.json", "orion-dev-output.jsonl", spot_timestamps)110 all_pass = True111 for t, src_q, hand_q, actual_q, verdict in spot_results:112 print(f" t={t}")113 if verdict == "MISSING":114 print(" MISSING data - cannot check")115 all_pass = False116 continue117 print(f" source quat_wxyz = {src_q}")118 print(f" hand-computed [x,z,y,-w] = {[round(c,8) for c in hand_q]}")119 print(f" actual quat_target = {[round(c,8) for c in actual_q]}")120 print(f" {verdict}")121 if verdict == "FAIL":122 all_pass = False123 print(f"RESULT: {'PASS' if all_pass else 'FAIL'}\n")124125 print("=== 3. Norm check (unit norm to 1e-9, every eval record) ===")126 norm_violations = check_norm(eval_records, tol=1e-9)127 print(f"n={len(eval_records)}, violations={len(norm_violations)}")128 if norm_violations:129 for seq, t, norm in norm_violations[:10]:130 print(f" seq={seq} t={t} norm={norm:.12f}")131 print(f"RESULT: {'PASS' if not norm_violations else 'FAIL'}\n")132133 overall = (not mag_violations) and all_pass and (not norm_violations)134 print(f"=== OVERALL: {'PASS' if overall else 'FAIL'} ===")135136137if __name__ == "__main__":138 main()139
